name: 智在记录
description: Connect Zhizai Record via official CLI to search notes, manage knowledge sets, scenes, teams, and recording cards.
description_zh: 通过官方 CLI 连接智在记录，用自然语言查询笔记、管理笔记集、场景、团队与录音卡。
description_en: Connect Zhizai Record via the official CLI to search notes and manage knowledge sets, scenes, teams, and recording cards.
examples_zh: 帮我提取本月所有客户的拜访纪要？
请对我近一周的面试记录，做一个评价分析总结
帮我汇总近一个月的所有待办事项，并标注负责人和截止时间
examples_en: Help me generate a weekly report
Summarize the content of this note
Help me extract all customer visit minutes from this month?
Please review and summarize my interview records from the past week
Help me summarize all to-do items from the past month, and mark the owners and deadlines
